findings.title: Boolean conversion of PublishReceipt may not match intent
findings.body: The change replaces `receipt.accepted` with `bool(receipt)`, which relies on the truthiness of `PublishReceipt` rather than explicitly checking the `accepted` attribute. If `PublishReceipt` defines `__bool__` to return something other than `receipt.accepted`, this alters the behavior. The original code was clearer and more explicit about its intent.

summary.problem: The change from `receipt.accepted` to `bool(receipt)` may alter the intended behavior of the `was_accepted` function.
summary.done_well: The PR is minimal and focused on a single function, making it easy to review.
